card: Adds the testsubmitpackage RPC command to test-validate a single transaction or a 1-parent-1-child package without mutating mempool state. Wallets constructing CPFP fee-bumps or testing replacement rules currently cannot dry-run package validation with aggregate package feerates and sibling eviction without actually submitting transactions to the mempool. To avoid complex state unrolling, it restricts packages to strict two-transaction child-with-parent topologies where the parent does not pass mempool acceptance on its own. The author notes this partially addresses issue #32160 by providing the package pre-flight testing functionality users requested.
changed_since_previous: Added a commit ('validation: match submission in package test-accept') that aligns test acceptance with submitpackage by disallowing sibling eviction in the multi-transaction acceptance path and waiting to report transaction success until the entire package passes script checks.
evidence: PR description: 'Intended as a wallet pre-flight check for CPFP fee-bumping packages. Enables rbf and sibling eviction evaluation, just like submitpackage.'
PR description: 'This is a partial addressing of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/32160, hopefully addressing most of the missing functionality people are requesting.'
problem: Wallets constructing CPFP fee-bumping packages or evaluating package RBF have no way to pre-flight test package acceptance without actually modifying the mempool. The testmempoolaccept RPC does not calculate aggregate package feerates or sibling eviction across unconfirmed transactions, while submitpackage immediately inserts valid transactions into the mempool.

risk.why: Modifies mempool acceptance logic in validation.cpp, where logic errors or violated assertions during dry-run package evaluation could cause node crashes or return misleading fee and replacement results to wallets.

scope_notes: The PR intentionally limits multi-transaction testing to strict 1p1c bundles where the parent cannot enter the mempool on its own, avoiding the need for complex state unrolling of accepted subpackages.
summary: Adds the testsubmitpackage RPC method to dry-run validation of a single transaction or a 1-parent-1-child (1p1c) package without mutating the mempool. Updates mempool validation internals to support package feerate aggregation and RBF replacement detection during dry-run validation. Shared JSON serialization logic between submitpackage and testsubmitpackage is unified into a common helper.
